## Comprehensive `descriptorId` Usage Analysis

### 1. Type Definitions — Where `descriptorId` is Declared

| File | Line | Declaration | Notes |

| `/navigation/navigation-state.ts` | 7 | `BreadcrumbNodeDescriptor.descriptorId?: string` | Used to build stack items from descriptors |
| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 28 | `DesktopBreadcrumbSegment.descriptorId?: string` | Segment shown in breadcrumb bar |
| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 51 | `BreadcrumbDropdownItem.descriptorId?: string` | Dropdown items in breadcrumb menus |
| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 84 | `BreadcrumbDropdownRule.matches(input, descriptorId)` | Rule dispatch parameter |
| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 134 | `buildFallbackDesktopSegment` input requires `descriptorId: string` | Non-optional in that helper |
| `/navigation/navigation-meta.ts` | 60 | `VirtualPageIndexNode.descriptorId: string` | Required field — references route registry |
| `/hooks/use-desktop-routing.ts` | 152 | `openPath` input `descriptorId?: string` | Accepted but currently ignored (not forwarded) |
| `/hooks/use-desktop-routing.ts` | 287 | `navigateTo` input `descriptorId?: string` | Same — accepted but not used in the implementation |
| `/hooks/use-page-tabs.ts` | 99, 274 | `navigateTo` / tab action input `descriptorId?: string` | Accepted in API but ignored in body |
| `/stores/tab-store.ts` | 49 | `TabViewModel.descriptorId?: string` | Computed field on view model |

---

| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 220, 338 | `"workspace"` | `/workspace/:workspaceId` |

| `/pages/agents/subagent-detail.tsx` | 215 | `"workspace-page"` | `/subagent/:configId?executor_type=...` (ATYPICAL — not actually a page URL) |
| `/pages/workspace-files.tsx` | 639 | `"workspace-section:files"` | `/workspace/:workspaceId/files` |
| `/pages/workspace-files.tsx` | 660 | `"virtual-folder"` | `/workspace/:workspaceId/files` (same href! — sub-folder pseudo-segments) |

### 3. Readers — Where `descriptorId` is Consumed

| File | Line | Usage |
|------|------|-------|
| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 248–249 | `resolveSegmentDescriptorId()` — returns `segment.descriptorId` if present, else derives from href |
| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 648 | Rule: `descriptorId === "workspace"` → show workspace switcher dropdown |
| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 662–663 | Rule: `(descriptorId === "virtual-folder" \|\| descriptorId === "settings") && href.startsWith("/settings/")` |
| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 679–680 | Rule: `descriptorId === "settings" && href === "/settings"` |
| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 695–696 | Rule: `(descriptorId === "virtual-folder" \|\| descriptorId === "workspace-section:pages") && href === /workspace/.../pages` |
| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 712–713 | Rule: `descriptorId?.startsWith("settings") && href.startsWith("/settings/")` |
| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 725–731 | Rule: `descriptorId?.startsWith("workspace-section:") && workspaceId exists` — extracts section name from descriptor |
| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 759–760 | Rule: `descriptorId === "workspace-page" && pages.length > 0` |
| `/navigation/page-index.ts` | 803 | `rules.find((rule) => rule.matches(input, descriptorId))` |
| `/components/navigation/desktop-breadcrumb-bar.tsx` | 30–41 | `inferDescriptorId()` — maps to `"workspace-web"`, `"workspace-page"`, `"workspace"`, `"settings"` |
| `/components/navigation/desktop-breadcrumb-bar.tsx` | 105 | Passes `inferDescriptorId(segment.href, segment.descriptorId)` to `openPath` |
| `/components/navigation/desktop-breadcrumb-bar.tsx` | 257 | `descriptorId: item.descriptorId` forwarded in `navigateWithTab` |
| `/components/navigation/navigation-shell.tsx` | 80 | `descriptorId: item.descriptorId` forwarded in `mapStackItemToSegment` |
| `/components/navigation/navigation-shell.tsx` | 94 | `root.descriptorId === "workspace"` — identifies workspace root to find `Workspace` object from `workspaces[]` by `workspaceId` |
| `/components/global-tab-bar/sortable-tab-item.tsx` | 42 | `getDescriptorIcon(tab.descriptorId)` — tab's icon fallback |
| `/navigation/breadcrumb-stack.ts` | 49 | `getDescriptorIcon(item.descriptorId)` — breadcrumb item's icon fallback |
| `/navigation/navigation-meta.ts` | 197–211 | `getDescriptorIcon(descriptorId)` — looks up icon from route registry or section maps using descriptor prefix patterns |
| `/stores/tab-store.test.ts` | 22 | `"descriptorId"` — mentioned in test |

---

### 4. The Critical Function: `resolveSegmentDescriptorId`

Located at `/navigation/page-index.ts:245–289`, this function **already implements full derivation from href** and is the cornerstone of any replacement plan:

```
href /workspace/:id              → "workspace"
href /workspace/:id/:section     → "workspace-section:{section}"
href /workspace/:id/(agent|agents) → "workspace-section:agent"
href /agent/:id                  → "workspace-agent"
href /executor/:id               → "workspace-executor"
href /workspace/:id/pages/:slug  → "workspace-page"
href /settings                   → "settings"
href /settings/:section          → "settings:{section}"
```

The rules in `resolvePageIndexBranch` all ultimately call `resolveSegmentDescriptorId(segment)` at line 619 before matching rules — meaning they already fall back to href-derived values when `descriptorId` is absent.

---

### 5. Cases Where `descriptorId` Carries Information NOT Derivable from `href`

**Three genuine exceptions exist:**

1. **`"workspace-web"`** (desktop-breadcrumb-bar.tsx line 31):
   The href for a web view is `/workspace/:workspaceId/web?url=...&title=...`. This does NOT appear in `resolveSegmentDescriptorId` — that function has no rule for `/workspace/:id/web`. So `"workspace-web"` is currently only passed explicitly and cannot be auto-derived without adding a new regex rule.

2. **`"virtual-folder"`** (workspace-files.tsx line 660, page-navigation-state.ts line 14):
   Both uses have `href` pointing to `/workspace/:workspaceId/files` or `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages` — the *same* href as the section root. The `"virtual-folder"` descriptor distinguishes sub-folder pseudo-segments (in the files browser) and the pages index from the actual section segment. This is inherently ambiguous when href alone is used because multiple segments share the same href.

3. **`"workspace-page"` on `/subagent/:configId`** (subagent-detail.tsx line 215):
   The href is `/subagent/:configId?executor_type=...`, which is a subagent detail route — not a pages route. The code incorrectly (or intentionally) assigns `"workspace-page"` to force specific dropdown behavior. The href provides no basis for this assignment.

4. **`"mcp-dashboard"` / `"skills-market"`** (use-desktop-routing.ts lines 877, 889):
   These are passed to `openPath` but `openPath` ignores `descriptorId` entirely in its implementation (it only uses `label`, `icon`, `workspaceId` from the input). So these values are set but never read through any code path — they are dead writes.

---

### 6. Summary: Derivability Assessment

| Value | href pattern | Derivable from href? |
|-------|-------------|---------------------|
| `"workspace"` | `/workspace/:id` | YES — already in `resolveSegmentDescriptorId` |
| `"workspace-section:{x}"` | `/workspace/:id/chat`, `/kanban`, etc. | YES |
| `"workspace-page"` | `/workspace/:id/pages/:slug+` | YES |
| `"workspace-agent"` | `/agent/:id` | YES |
| `"workspace-executor"` | `/executor/:id` or `/workspace/:id/executor/:type` | YES |
| `"settings"` | `/settings` | YES |
| `"settings:{section}"` | `/settings/:section` | YES |
| `"workspace-web"` | `/workspace/:id/web?url=...` | NO — needs new rule added to `resolveSegmentDescriptorId` |
| `"virtual-folder"` | `/workspace/:id/pages` or `/workspace/:id/files` | AMBIGUOUS — shares href with section root; rule matching in page-index already handles it via href + label comparison |
| `"workspace-page"` on `/subagent/:configId` | `/subagent/:configId?executor_type=...` | NO — this is a misuse; the subagent url would derive `undefined` or a new descriptor |
| `"mcp-dashboard"`, `"skills-market"` | `/mcp-services/dashboard`, `/skills-market` | YES (could add rules) — but currently dead writes anyway |

### 7. Key Architectural Notes

- **`tab-store.ts` line 239** is a subtle divergence: `TabViewModel.descriptorId` is set to `leaf?.pattern` (the route pattern like `/workspace/:workspaceId/chat`), NOT the `leaf.descriptorId` string. This `pattern`-based value is then passed to `getDescriptorIcon()` in `sortable-tab-item.tsx`. Since `getDescriptorIcon` first tries `registry.getIcon(descriptorId)`, and the registry is indexed by pattern, this means tab icons work via route registry lookup using the pattern string, bypassing the `descriptorId` field entirely.

- **`navigation-shell.tsx` line 94** is the one place where `descriptorId === "workspace"` is tested to resolve which `Workspace` object to pass to the breadcrumb bar. If `descriptorId` were removed, this check would need to use `root.meta?.workspaceId` directly (which is already also set) — a trivial change.

- All dropdown rule matching in `resolvePageIndexBranch` already goes through `resolveSegmentDescriptorId`, which has fallback href-based derivation. The explicit `descriptorId` field on segments only helps when the href alone is ambiguous (the `"virtual-folder"` and `"workspace-web"` cases above).
